name: Petal Browser Expressive Gestures Plan
description: Comprehensive specification and implementation roadmap for modern gesture-driven navigation in Petal Browser, inspired by Firefox for Android (Fenix) and Chrome for Android.

architecture.touchArbitration: Layered gesture isolation to prevent collisions between GeckoView web content (canvases, horizontal carousels, maps) and browser UI controls.
architecture.apzIntegration: SafeGeckoView PanZoomController input detail querying to safely detect overscroll and unhandled touch before intercepting pull or edge gestures.
architecture.physicsEngine: Material 3 Expressive spring physics with damping ratio 0.75-0.85 and stiffness 400-500 for natural finger tracking and haptic ticks.

phases.title: Edge Back / Forward Navigation Swipe
phases.reference: Firefox Fenix edge-swipe navigation & Chrome history swipe gestures

tasks.title: Create PetalEdgeSwipeLayout
tasks.description: Custom layout / pointerInput wrapper around PetalGeckoView capturing edge touches within a configurable boundary (16dp-32dp) from the left and right screen borders.

tasks.title: Fluid Predictive Arrow & Pill Indicator
tasks.description: Render interactive, spring-backed edge chevron with background circular blur and tactile haptic pulse upon crossing confirmation threshold.

tasks.title: Wire GeckoView Back/Forward Navigation
tasks.description: Invoke SafeGeckoView canGoBack()/goBack() and canGoForward()/goForward() safely upon release past the trigger threshold.

phases.title: Address Bar Gestures & Tab Scrubbing
phases.reference: Chrome & Firefox toolbar scrub to switch tabs and pull down for tab grid

tasks.title: Horizontal Tab Scrubbing with Visual Offset
tasks.description: Upgrade PetalAddressBar horizontal drag to translate adjacent tab previews with 1:1 finger tracking, switching to previous/next tab upon drag completion.

tasks.title: Address Bar Swipe-Down to Open Tab Grid Switcher
tasks.description: Detect downward vertical flick/drag on the top or bottom address bar pill to directly invoke showOverview() / PetalTabGridSwitcher.

tasks.title: Haptic Detents on Scrub Steps
tasks.description: Trigger light PetalHapticEngine.Pattern.TICK on crossing tab switch thresholds to give tactile confirmation.

phases.title: Bottom Navigation Bar & Quick Action Gestures
phases.reference: Firefox long-press quick tab menu & browser navigation gestures

tasks.title: Tab Counter Long-Press Menu
tasks.description: Long-pressing the tab counter pill opens an expressive quick action popup: 'New Tab', 'New Private Tab', 'Close Active Tab', and 'Close All Tabs'.

tasks.title: Modernize SwipeTouchListener for Navigation Buttons
tasks.description: Refactor legacy SwipeTouchListener on fab_menu and fab_overview into Kotlin with velocity tracking and haptic feedback.

phases.title: Settings & Gesture Customization UI
phases.reference: Material 3 Expressive settings screen with interactive toggles and sensitivity options

tasks.title: Settings Integration in AddressBarSettingsScreen
tasks.description: Add settings toggles for Edge Swipe Navigation, Address Bar Swipe Down for Tabs, and Sensitivity Slider.

tasks.title: Preferences Repository & SharedPreferences Binding
tasks.description: Store gesture preferences with reactive StateFlow in SettingsRepository and SettingsRepositoryImpl.

verificationCriteria: Web content gestures (Google Maps pan/zoom, web carousels, games) are never hijacked by edge or swipe gestures.
Compatibility with Android 14+ Predictive Back gestures.
Zero layout thrashing and 60/120fps motion maintained via graphicsLayer RenderThread execution.
All settings changes reflect instantaneously without needing app restart.
